name: source
title: wsync source
description: Prints an instance's script source from live Studio, or the content of the file backing it on disk.
notes: Without `--disk`, reads the live `Source` through the plugin's `ScriptEditorService` path. Live source is unreliable while an editor draft is open for that script, so a mismatch is not by itself proof of divergence.
`--disk` resolves the target through the sync middleware, so `.model.json`, `.rbxm`, and `.data.json`-backed instances answer as well as plain script files.
This is a loose divergence diagnostic, not a verification step. To verify an edit, use the narrowest `wsync lint --path` plus a local file read.
